title: tpu-performance-optimization Request
description: Input payload for the tpu-performance-optimization agent: rank the performance gaps of one served job from its tpu-forward-bench baseline and propose hypotheses for the top ones. It runs no benchmark and changes no code.

run_id.description: The caller's run; artifacts go under it.

engine.description: The inference engine the source job served with. Values are added as engines gain a procedure section.

model.description: The served model id, e.g. zai-org/GLM-5.2-FP8.

accelerator_type.description: Generation and chip count, e.g. tpu7x-8.

baseline.description: Path of a `measured` forward-bench-result whose baseline arm was profiled: its report, plan, cost_model, evidence and traces are the inputs.

source_job.description: The served job the baseline was derived from; its recipe.yaml is passed to tpu-roofline as context.

roofline.description: Path of a `modeled` roofline-result at the plan's cells. Absent: the agent requests one from tpu-roofline.

checkout.description: Local checkout of the engine plugin at the image's revision (vllm: vllm-torchtpu), read while diagnosing and forming hypotheses. Absent: plugin code locations are written as unknown.

metric.description: The metric regime weights are taken against.

tried.description: Levers already tested on this job, from the caller's ledger. Not proposed again unless the evidence changed.

outcome.description: The verdict or stop class, e.g. win, loss, refuted, budget.

evidence.description: The A/B result or gap file behind the outcome.

top_n.description: How many ranked gaps get a full diagnosis and hypotheses.
